name: Investigate BRO-318 stale-backpointer recurrence: dedupe-same-url-bylines.js gate vs fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js gap
previousNotes:
## Problem
loves-labours-lost-globe-west-end-2026 hit the exact BRO-318 bug class (stale duplicateTextOf backpointer on a canonical review, causing a duplicate-URL entry in reviews.json and reddening main CI's Unit Tests job) on 2026-08-22, even though this class already has: (1) a regression test at tests/unit/dedupe-same-url-bylines-stale-canonical.test.mjs, and (2) a CI gate (`node scripts/dedupe-same-url-bylines.js --gate` in test.yml:4246) plus a dedicated fix workflow (dedupe-same-url-bylines.yml). The instance that actually broke was repaired via a DIFFERENT tool, scripts/fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js, which has ZERO CI coverage (confirmed: grep -n "fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer" .github/workflows/*.yml returns nothing) and is manual-only.

## Evidence
- Fixed instance: data/review-texts/loves-labours-lost-globe-west-end-2026/times-uk--clive-davis.json had duplicateOf:null (already cleared by a prior "canonical-backpointer-repair" stamp) but duplicateTextOf still pointing at times-uk--david-jays-and-maxie-szalwinska.json — a mutual-pointer pattern that rebuild-all-reviews.js's circular-tiebreak logic (scripts/rebuild-all-reviews.js ~line 2369-2385, 2461-2469) reads as "ambiguous, keep both" when content fingerprints differ (they differed here because the canonical's scraped fullText had a quiz-widget prefix contaminating it).
- Fix applied this session: `REVIEW_TEXTS_DIR=<clone> node scripts/fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js --show=loves-labours-lost-globe-west-end-2026 --apply`, pushed to thomaspryor/broadway-review-texts (commit b5b4ec27), rebuild-reviews.yml re-run, verified locally (validate-data.js exits 0) and in production (curl broadwayscorecard.com/data/shows/loves-labours-lost-globe-west-end-2026.json shows only 1 Times UK review now).
- fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js's own docstring says 386 latent instances existed corpus-wide as of 2026-08-17, "most benign" — implying an unknown number are NOT benign and could redden main the same way, with nothing proactively catching them.
- Related: scripts/fix-circular-duplicate-pairs.js handles the duplicateOf-only half of this same class per fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js's own header comment ("scripts/fix-circular-duplicate-pairs.js already repairs A.duplicateOf=B + B.duplicateOf=A. It does NOT look at duplicateTextOf, so this shape survives").

## Suggested approach
1. Read scripts/dedupe-same-url-bylines.js's fix() in full and compare its stale-backpointer-clearing logic against scripts/fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js's planCanonicalPointerClear (scripts/lib/canonical-duplicate-pointers.js) — are these two genuinely separate bug classes (byline-explosion-collapse vs some other duplicate-creation path) that both need independent guards, or is one a subset/superset of the other that should share code?
2. Check whether dedupe-same-url-bylines.js's --gate would have caught the loves-labours-lost instance if run today, or whether it's structurally blind to backpointers left by whatever process stamped "canonical-backpointer-repair" on clive-davis.json in the first place (grep review-texts history / data/audit/ for when/how that stamp was applied — was it a prior fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js --apply run that only got partway, or a different script reusing the same stamp text?).
3. Once the gap is understood, close it: either (a) extend dedupe-same-url-bylines.js's --gate to also catch fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js's corruption shape, or (b) add fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js --all as a new "lifetime sweep (shadow mode)" step in .github/workflows/data-health-check.yml, following the existing pattern for cv-wrongproduction/slug-mismatch/roundup-url-mismatch/revival-unverified (non-blocking, writes a data/audit/*.json snapshot, surfaced via health-check.js digest check) — so the next of the 386 latent instances is caught before it reddens main, not after.

## What was already tried
N/A — this is a fresh investigation prompted by this session's incident fix, not a repeat of a failed attempt.

## Acceptance criteria
- Root cause of the tool-overlap/gap is documented (in the fix commit message or a memory/ file if it meets the encode-first bar).
- Either CI gate coverage is extended to catch this corruption shape, or a scheduled shadow-mode sweep of fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js is added to data-health-check.yml and its digest check verified to surface non-zero counts.
- `node scripts/fix-canonical-duplicate-backpointer.js --all --yes` (dry-run) run once to get a current corpus-wide count, logged in the card outcome for baseline.

name: P1: morning-digest's real (non-refused) auto-fix dispatch is unguarded by any checkout-freshness OR complete kill-switch coverage — LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED never set
previousNotes:
PARKED: Owner judgment call: is un-gated Linear dispatch from morning-digest intentional per the 2026-08-02 auto-fix mandate, or should LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED=1 be added? A prior related card was closed on a possibly-incomplete read of this exact env var.

## Problem
While fixing task #1818 (morning-digest sync-refusal circular alert), found that com.broadwayscore.morning-digest.plist's BSC_RUNNER_DISABLED=1 env var — whose stated purpose (plist comment, lines 28-35) is to prevent "a stray digest-triggered auto-fix run" from ever launching "a headless bsc-next job from this job" — does NOT cover the CURRENT primary dispatch routing path.

## Evidence
- scripts/linear-next.js:513-514: "killSwitchEnv: this dispatcher answers to LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED only — BSC_RUNNER_DISABLED (the retired Notion-loop's plist switch, #1311) must not gate the Linear path at the runner level (BRO-286)."
- `grep -rn LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED scripts/launchd/*.plist` returns NOTHING — no plist anywhere sets it.
- scripts/lib/digest-autofix.js's dispatchDetached routes real dispatches to `linear:BRO-N` taskIds via `scripts/linear-next.js --headless` (per BRO-286 comments throughout that file, e.g. line 524-531) — this is the CURRENT primary path, not the legacy bsc-next.js path BSC_RUNNER_DISABLED still gates.
- A prior card on this exact env var (3ba637c5-416f-81cf-af2a-c1348e359af1, closed 2026-08-14) concluded "safety switch working as designed" but its own closing note says the switch was "deliberately set to keep the RETIRED Notion-side loop from spawning" — i.e. that investigation confirmed the switch covers only the retired path, which is consistent with (not a refutation of) this finding; it doesn't appear to have checked whether the CURRENT Linear path is covered.
- send-morning-digest.js's real (non-dry-run) runAutofix()/runAutofixCanary() calls happen EVERY morning at 07:30 ET on a normal clean checkout (this is intentional per the 2026-08-02 owner "Digest v3 auto-fix" mandate — the digest is supposed to dispatch real fix sessions). The open question is narrower: is un-gated Linear dispatch from this specific job acceptable, or was BSC_RUNNER_DISABLED meant to be a hard stop for ALL headless spawns from morning-digest regardless of routing, in which case LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED=1 should be added to the plist too?

## Root cause
BRO-286 (Notion→Linear routing migration) introduced a second, independent kill-switch env var (LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED) without auditing which existing plists relied on the OLD kill-switch (BSC_RUNNER_DISABLED) to fully suppress headless spawns and needed the new one added alongside it.

## Suggested approach
Owner judgment needed on intent, then either:
(a) Add `LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED=1` to morning-digest.plist's EnvironmentVariables + reload the live launchd job (`launchctl bootout`/`bootstrap`), restoring the plist's originally-stated "never launches a headless job from this job" guarantee across BOTH routing paths, or
(b) Update the plist's header comment (lines 28-35) to accurately scope BSC_RUNNER_DISABLED to "legacy bsc-next.js routing only" and explicitly document that Linear-routed real dispatch from this job IS intentional per the 2026-08-02 auto-fix mandate, closing the stale/misleading-documentation gap instead.
Task #1818's fix (autofixShouldDryRun, scripts/send-morning-digest.js) already handles the ADJACENT, more urgent case (stale/dirty checkout) by forcing both paths into dry-run regardless of this gap — this card is about the steady-state clean-checkout case only.

## What was already tried
None — this is a fresh finding from #1818's review process (gpt-5.4-mini adversarial pass + follow-up code investigation), not previously actioned on this exact angle.

## Acceptance criteria
Owner decides (a) or (b) above; whichever is chosen, `grep -rn LINEAR_NEXT_DISABLED scripts/launchd/` should either show the new entry (a) or the plist comment should no longer claim blanket headless-spawn protection it doesn't provide (b).

name: P1: londontheatre.co.uk reviews silently lost — missing article-extractor PATTERNS entry
previousNotes:
NO-DISPATCH: Filed from the headless opening-night monitor mid-pass; spawning a workspace from a launchd bounded pass would race the monitor's own data-repo commits.

## Problem
Reviews from londontheatre.co.uk (Official London Theatre — a DISTINCT outlet from the already-registered LondonTheatre1) are fetched successfully but silently discarded at extraction. scripts/lib/article-extractor.js has no PATTERNS entry for the domain, so extraction returns ~102 chars and the review never becomes a scoreable file. Fetch succeeds, so nothing is logged: no exclusion-log entry, no gate rejection, no stage-latency event. The outlet looks like it never published rather than like it failed. Every West End opening loses it.

## Evidence
Opening-night monitor attempt 69, 2026-08-20 16:36Z, show abigails-party-west-end-2026:
`node scripts/ingest-review-from-url.js --show=abigails-party-west-end-2026 --url=https://www.londontheatre.co.uk/reviews/abigails-party-review-harold-pinter-theatre`
Output: `Using Playwright (public site)... Success (Playwright, html)` then `Article extraction returned 102 chars — pattern may be missing for this outlet. Add an entry to scripts/lib/article-extractor.js PATTERNS.`
The review is real and current (Tamzin Outhwaite, Harold Pinter Theatre, published 2026-08-20) and is absent from https://broadwayscorecard.com/data/shows/abigails-party-west-end-2026.json (9 reviews live, cs 84.73).

## Approach
1. Add a londontheatre.co.uk entry to PATTERNS in scripts/lib/article-extractor.js (inspect the page DOM for the article container selector).
2. Confirm the outlet exists in data/outlet-registry.json with region=uk and the correct domain, not colliding with LondonTheatre1.
3. Re-run the ingest command above, then rebuild -> score -> rebuild.
4. Generalise: make a sub-threshold extraction (<300 chars) after a SUCCESSFUL fetch write to the data/audit/ exclusion log instead of only printing to stdout. That silence is the real bug.

## What was already tried
The monitor pass ran the direct-URL ingest above; it is the fastest repro. No extractor pattern was written (pass had a 15-minute wall-clock cap). The same pass DID successfully recover The Independent for this show by the same command, so the ingest path itself is healthy — the failure is extractor-pattern-specific.

## Acceptance criteria
- `node scripts/ingest-review-from-url.js --show=abigails-party-west-end-2026 --url=https://www.londontheatre.co.uk/reviews/abigails-party-review-harold-pinter-theatre` reports >1500 chars and contentTier complete or truncated.
- londontheatre.co.uk appears in the reviews array of https://broadwayscorecard.com/data/shows/abigails-party-west-end-2026.json.
- A short-extraction event for a successful fetch is greppable under data/audit/.

name: P1: 7 backlog cards (4 P1) still shape-2 undispatchable after task #1713's SAFE_CHECK_FORMS widening
previousNotes:
NO-DISPATCH: continuation of just-completed task #1713 -- needs individual per-candidate judgment calls (card-authoring fixes vs real tokenizer work vs deliberate exclusions), not a mechanical one-shot dispatch; better as owner-reviewed backlog

## Problem
Task #1713 widened SAFE_CHECK_FORMS to reclaim 11 of 18 shape-2 refused cards (real command present, wrongly rejected by the safe-form allowlist). 7 remain refused, 4 of them P1 Next priority. Their candidate commands need real, individually-scoped work, not another blanket allowlist add -- each one is a genuinely different shape than the file-path-based forms SAFE_CHECK_FORMS already supports.

## Evidence
`node scripts/audit-card-verifiability.js` then filter data/audit/card-verifiability.json's `refused` array for reason including "no acceptance-criteria command passed safe-form validation". Remaining candidates as of 2026-08-17:
- `node scripts/extract-show-score-reviews.js` (P1) -- deliberately excluded from #1713's widening: writes data/show-score.json + data/audit/show-score-extraction-gaps.json on every run, non-idempotent-safe for unattended re-verification (MUTATING_SCRIPT_RE-class risk)
- `gh run list --workflow="Deploy to Vercel" --limit 5 --json status,conclusion` (P1) and `gh run list --workflow="Test Suite" --branch=main --limit=1 --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion'` (P1) -- NOT a `node scripts/*.js` shape at all; cardCheckArgv (scripts/lib/autonomous-checks.js) tokenizes commands with a naive whitespace split, which would mis-tokenize the quoted `--workflow="Deploy to Vercel"` value even if a gh-run-list SAFE_CHECK_FORM were added
- `grep -rn '!\s*\w+\.openingDate)\s*\(return\|continue\)' scripts/audit-*.js` (P1) -- a search/investigation command, not a real pass/fail verification; the card itself likely needs its acceptance criteria rewritten, not the allowlist widened
- `node scripts/lib/test-data-write-guard.js` (P2) -- WRONG PATH: the real CLI wrapper is scripts/test-data-write-guard.js (no /lib/); scripts/lib/test-data-write-guard.js is the pure-logic module with no `require.main === module` block. Card-authoring bug, not an allowlist gap.
- `node --test <new-test-file>` (P2) -- literal unfilled LLM placeholder, never got a real path. Needs re-enrichment via `node scripts/enrich-card-acceptance.js --cards <id>`.
- `bash scripts/link-worktree-data.sh` (P2) -- a shell script with unvetted side effects; needs the same read-before-allowlisting review #1713 did for the 8 scripts it added.

## Suggested approach
Three separate, independently-scoped fixes:
1. Card-authoring fixes (no code change): re-enrich the wrong-path and placeholder cards via `node scripts/enrich-card-acceptance.js --cards <id1>,<id2>`, and manually correct the grep-as-verify card's acceptance criteria to name a real test instead.
2. extract-show-score-reviews.js: either add a --check/--dry-run read-only mode that diffs against the committed data/show-score.json without writing, or leave excluded (own judgment call).
3. gh run list support: extend cardCheckArgv (scripts/lib/autonomous-checks.js) with a quote-aware tokenizer (shlex-style) before any gh-run-list SAFE_CHECK_FORM is added -- the naive whitespace split is a correctness bug independent of this card, and adding a new form without fixing it would silently break on any quoted argument.

## What was already tried
Task #1713 (2026-08-16/17) widened SAFE_CHECK_FORMS for 8 read-only scripts (validate-data.js, scoring-delta.js, test-temporal-override-regression.js, 5 audit-*.js scripts), reclaiming 11 of 18 shape-2 cards. Deliberately did NOT add extract-show-score-reviews.js (mutates data), gh run list (non-file-path shape + tokenizer bug), node -e (arbitrary code execution), or bash scripts (unvetted) -- see scripts/lib/autonomous-triage-core.js's SAFE_CHECK_FORMS comment block for the full reasoning.

## Acceptance criteria
`node scripts/audit-card-verifiability.js` reports 0 shape-2 refusals ("no acceptance-criteria command passed safe-form validation") remaining, either because each card's own acceptance criteria was corrected, or (for extract-show-score-reviews.js/gh run list) a genuinely safe form was added after fixing cardCheckArgv's tokenizer.

`node scripts/audit-card-verifiability.js` then filter data/audit/card-verifiability.json's `refused` array for reason including "no acceptance-criteria command passed safe-form validation". Remaining candidates as of 2026-08-17:
- `node scripts/extract-show-score-reviews.js` (P1) -- deliberately excluded from #1713's widening: writes data/show-score.json + data/audit/show-score-extraction-gaps.json on every run, non-idempotent-safe for unattended re-verification (MUTATING_SCRIPT_RE-class risk)
- `gh run list --workflow="Deploy to Vercel" --limit 5 --json status,conclusion` (P1) and `gh run list --workflow="Test Suite" --branch=main --limit=1 --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion'` (P1) -- NOT a `node scripts/*.js` shape at all; cardCheckArgv (scripts/lib/autonomous-checks.js) tokenizes commands with a naive whitespace split, which would mis-tokenize the quoted `--workflow="Deploy to Vercel"` value even if a gh-run-list SAFE_CHECK_FORM were added

name: Corpus-wide sibling-misfile archive cleanup: 158 shows found in Show Score archive
previousNotes:
PARKED: needs owner call: delete archives now vs let CI regenerate; scope covers 2 more aggregators

## Problem
BRO-363 (fixed 2026-08-15) added a page-level sibling-misfile guard to extract-show-score-reviews.js and extract-dtli-reviews.js: when >=50% (min 3) of an archived aggregator page's dated critic reviews date-match a same-title SIBLING's opening instead of the target show's own, the whole page is rejected (Show Score) or its thumb-count summary is skipped (DTLI). This was built to fix 3 regional-to-Broadway transfer shows (two-strangers, little-bear-ridge-road, the-outsiders) but running it against the FULL local Show Score archive corpus found 158 shows hit by the same pattern — mostly historical revivals sharing a title with the CURRENT production (Show Score only lists the current run, so fetch-aggregator-pages.ts's slug-guess for any of them lands on the same page). Example: a-christmas-carol-1991/1994/2001/2019 all archived data/aggregator-archive/show-score/{id}.html as a-christmas-carol-2022's page (confirmed: same 8 critic reviews, all dated to the 2022 opening, showScoreUrl: null on all 4). Confirmed the SAME pattern exists in the dtli/ archive subdir too (a-christmas-carol-1994.html's DTLI page is titled for the 2019 Broadway cast, not 1994).

## Evidence
Run (from a worktree with data/aggregator-archive symlinked to the real archive checkout and data/review-texts populated):
`node scripts/extract-show-score-reviews.js` — count REJECT lines starting with `sibling-misfile:` in the output; each names the wrongly-filed show id and the sibling it's actually about.

## Root cause
Already fixed going forward (the guard now prevents new extraction from writing wrong data). NOT yet fixed retroactively: (1) the stale archive HTML files themselves still sit in the private aggregator-archive repo (broadway-review-texts) for all 158 shows, wasting scrape/extraction cycles every run; (2) any review-text stub files these may have ALREADY produced in data/review-texts before the guard existed were never audited at this scale (only the original 3 BRO-363 shows were checked).

## Suggested approach
1. Extend audit-sibling-title-misroute.js (or write a sibling script) to ALSO scan data/aggregator-archive/{show-score,dtli}/ directly (not just data/review-texts) for the sibling-misfile pattern, reusing extract-show-score-reviews.js's now-existing detection logic (classifyMarketRouting majority vote) — report the full list without needing a local archive checkout dance.
2. For confirmed hits: delete the stale archive HTML from broadway-review-texts (same pattern as BRO-363's 5 deletions, commits 49fdbbcca4d/b8086e56e03).
3. Cross-check data/review-texts for each of the 158 show ids for any pre-existing show-score-sourced stub files (source: 'show-score' or 'dtli' with wrongProduction unset) that predate the guard — clear/reroute via audit-sibling-title-misroute.js --fix (manual, supervised, per its own doc comment).
4. Re-run extract-show-score-reviews.js + extract-dtli-reviews.js after cleanup; confirm 0 REJECT lines for the 158 (archives gone, nothing left to reject).

## What was already tried
BRO-363 fixed the write-time/extraction-time guards (already on main) and cleaned the 3 shows named in that card. This card is the retroactive corpus-wide cleanup the guard's own discovery run surfaced but which was out of scope for a single-show bug fix.

## Acceptance criteria
`node scripts/extract-show-score-reviews.js` output contains 0 lines matching `sibling-misfile:` (after archive cleanup, none are left to reject in the first place — the guard firing zero times is the success state, not the guard catching things forever).

name: 4 more scripts carry the unreviewed !openingDate guard (cousin of #1409)
previousNotes:
PARKED: each needs a per-file judgment call (correctly date-bound like the 4 already-declined files, or a live blind spot like the 3 already fixed) before any code changes -- not safely auto-dispatchable

## Problem
The null-openingDate blind-spot fix (card 3bb637c5-416f-8113-9f4a-e6970196c226, this session) covered 3 files (audit-show-review-gap.js, audit-opening-night-coverage.js, audit-standing-coverage.js) and explicitly declared 4 others out of scope (audit-pre2005-reviews.js, audit-awards-data.js, audit-cross-production.js, audit-serp-census-recall.js). A broader grep found 4 MORE files with the same bare guard that were never triaged either way:

## Evidence
grep -rn '!\s*\w+\.openingDate' scripts/audit-*.js (filtered to return-false/continue forms)
  scripts/audit-cv-flag-contradiction.js:82   if (!s.openingDate) return false;
  scripts/audit-duplicate-shows.js:65         return reviewCount === 0 && (!v || v === 'tba' || !show.openingDate);
  scripts/audit-opera-discovery-gap.js:101    if (!s.openingDate) return false;
  scripts/audit-tony-attribution.js:95        if (!show.openingDate) continue; // unknown opening — separate check

## Root cause
Same class as #1409: a null openingDate can silently drop a live previews-status show from an audit's population.

## Suggested approach
For each file: read what the guard's surrounding function actually computes (some may be legitimately date-bound like the already-declined 4, e.g. audit-tony-attribution.js's comment suggests it may deliberately separate 'unknown opening' shows for its own reason). Where it's a live blind spot, apply the same showRecencyKey()/NO_DATE_SENTINEL fallback from scripts/lib/collection-priority.js used in the reference fix (scripts/audit-show-review-gap.js:638-647). Where it's correctly date-bound, add a comment explaining why (matching how audit-serp-census-recall.js:182 already documents its intentional undated-only selection) so the next grep sweep doesn't re-flag it.

## What was already tried
Nothing yet -- discovered via /what-else during #1409's session, not investigated further.

## Acceptance criteria
For each of the 4 files, either: (a) fixed with the reference pattern + verified via a real-corpus population diff (old subset of new, zero regressions), or (b) explicitly declined with an inline comment. `grep -rn '!\s*\w+\.openingDate)\s*\(return\|continue\)' scripts/audit-*.js` should show zero UNEXPLAINED occurrences when done.

CLAUDE.md content (esp. rule 18 infra-review-gate paragraph, rule 14 opening-night automation-chain detail, and various parenthetical [[memory-link]] citations) has grown past the byte cap enforced by test.yml's integrity-anchor step.

Per CLAUDE.md's own File Hygiene rule ('New topics → memory/{topic}.md + one-line pointer'): move verbose operational detail (e.g. rule 14's opening-night cron-time enumeration, rule 18's full gate mechanics) into memory/CLAUDE-reference.md or a new memory/ file, leaving a one-line pointer in CLAUDE.md. Nothing — discovered while verifying card #1112's fix on live CI; deliberately not fixed inline to avoid a rushed edit to a fleet-wide policy file.

`wc -c CLAUDE.md` under 14336
test.yml 'Lint Workflows' → 'Audit — CLAUDE.md integrity anchors + byte cap' step passes on a live CI run

name: CI Test Suite red on main since 2026-05-02 — contamination audit (7 strict) + npm audit high severity
previousNotes:
## Problem
Test Suite has been failing on main since 2026-05-02 (last green: run 25205890278 on 2026-05-01 07:01 UTC). Multiple independent failures stack — fixing one surfaces the next. After fixing oliver-west-end-2024 originalScore on 2026-05-08 (commit bd48dc5bf9a in private review-texts), CI run 25584852760 surfaced the contamination audit + dependency audit failures that were previously masked.

## Evidence
Run 25584852760 (2026-05-08 23:38 UTC) failures, two independent jobs:

Data Validation > Audit review contamination (`scripts/audit-review-contamination.js --strict`):
- 7 strict-class issues across 36563 files / 1686 shows
- B_false_positive_wp: 6 — cats-the-jellicle-ball-off-broadway-2024 OB-superseded reviews (cititour, exeunt, nytimes, vulture/Sara Holdren) flagged as wrongProduction with note 'OB review superseded by Broadway transfer'; fat-ham-2023/hollywood-reporter--lovia-gyarkye flagged with empty wrongProductionNote
- C_domain_mismatch: 1 — matilda-the-musical-west-end-2021/metro--claire-allfree.json has rawInternalOutlet=metro but URL domain is theatrevibe.co.uk; expected outlet theatre-vibe
- C2_url_multi_critic: 3 — same URL attributed to two different critics in same show directory:
  - gutenberg-2023: variety--aramide-tinubu.json + variety--frank-rizzo.json (same Variety URL)
  - marjorie-prime-2025: nytg--gillian-russo.json + nytg--joe-dziemianowicz.json (same NYTG URL)
  - oklahoma-2019: nytimes--ben-brantley.json + nytimes--jesse-green.json (same NYT URL)
- Non-strict (warnings only): D_pre_opening_feature: 104 (pre-opening feature articles miscategorized as reviews)

Dependency Audit > npm audit (critical only):
- @babel/plugin-transform-modules-systemjs 7.12.0 - 7.29.0 (high severity, GHSA-fv7c-fp4j-7gwp)
- Step is named 'critical only' but is failing on high — possibly recent advisory landed and audit-level config needs update, OR step intentionally fails on high
- Fix available via npm audit fix (likely safe, transitive dep)

## Suggested approach
Tackle in order:

1. Dependency audit: run `npm audit fix` locally, verify build still succeeds, commit. If audit step truly should only fail on critical, update test.yml audit-level to critical. Likely 5 min.

2. C2_url_multi_critic (3 issues): each is an obvious bad-data case — same URL can't have two different critics. Pick the correct critic per URL (check the actual URL to see byline), delete the wrong file, push to private review-texts repo, run rebuild-reviews. ~15 min.

3. C_domain_mismatch (1 issue): matilda metro/theatre-vibe — verify the URL, rename file or fix outlet attribution. ~5 min.

4. B_false_positive_wp (6 issues): the 'OB review superseded by Broadway transfer' note is a class of automatic flagging that the strict audit considers contamination. Either:
   (a) move the OB reviews to the Broadway transfer entry where they belong, or
   (b) update the audit script to allow the explicit OB-superseded-by-transfer note as legitimate, not contamination
   The fat-ham case needs an empty-wrongProductionNote investigation. ~30-60 min.

5. After all green: investigate why this didn't surface earlier. The Test Suite job exits at first error, so multiple stacked issues mean fixing one surfaces the next. Consider making validators emit all errors in one pass, then exit non-zero if any.

## What was already tried
This session (2026-05-08 19:30 PT): fixed oliver-west-end-2024 originalScore, which was the failure visible in 25582016560. New CI run revealed 7 contamination + dependency audit failures that were previously hidden behind the oliver error.

## Acceptance criteria
- `gh run list --workflow="Test Suite" --branch=main --limit=1 --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion'` returns 'success'
- node scripts/audit-review-contamination.js --strict exits 0
- npm audit --audit-level=high exits 0 (or audit step explicitly tuned)
- 5 consecutive green Test Suite runs on main
